title: A Low-Carb Approach to Treat Type 2 Diabetes in Pediatric Patients
official: Carb Control: Low-Carbohydrate Dietary Intervention for Pediatric Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
summary: The purpose of this project is to test the effect of a low carb diet compared to standard carb diet among adolescents with T2D over a 24-week period.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 12-18
* Diabetes diagnosis \>3 months to ensure stable baseline glycemic control
* HbA1C between 6.5- 8.5%
* BMI \>85th percentile
* Negative pancreatic autoantibodies
* Stable dose of anti-diabetic drugs GLP-1, metformin, SGLT-2 inhibitors, for 3 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current insulin treatment
* Renal impairment measured as creatinine \> 1 mg/dL
* Hepatic dysfunction measured as AST and ALT \>100 IU/ml
